description: ElevenLabs voice reference. Copy voice IDs directly from the API or ElevenLabs dashboard.

eleven_turbo_v2_5.note: Use this by default. Great quality, half the cost of multilingual v2.

eleven_flash_v2_5.note: Fastest and cheapest. Good for video demos. Slightly lower quality.

eleven_multilingual_v2.note: Only use if you need multilingual support or premium quality. 2x the cost.

rachel.note: returned paid_plan_required on a free tier

natural.note: Balanced - natural variation in speech, clear similarity to voice

_voice_id_warning: Two ids in this file used to 404: alice and jessica were Xb7hH8MSUJpSbvxk5AI5 and cgSgspJ2msm4f57DCYsx, which are corrupted variants of the real ones. Every id below marked verified:true returned audio from the API on 2026-08-25. Do not add an id here without calling it.
_scoped_key_note: A TTS-scoped key cannot list voices or read the subscription -- GET /v1/voices and /v1/user/subscription both 401 with 'missing_permissions'. That is not a bad key; synthesis still works. It does mean you cannot discover voice ids at runtime, hence this file.

dubbing.note: dub-clips.py uses multilingual_v2 with the /with-timestamps endpoint, which is what supplies word timings for the captions. speed outside 0.7-1.2 is rejected outright; measured, that is -30%/+20%, against edge-tts's -25%/+45%.
